chunks: How will it be when the angels draw out their souls, striking their faces and their backs?

key_terms.تَوَفَّتْهُمُ: They cause to die / draw out the souls

ai.seo_question: What happens to the soul at death for those who mixed faith with disbelief?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse highlights the physical manifestation of spiritual duality, where the 'face' represents outward faith and the 'back' signifies inner hypocrisy, resulting in a dual punishment. The angels' striking action serves as a tangible sign of the soul's extraction from those who mixed truth with falsehood, a concept deeply explored in tafsirs like Al-Mizan. This moment underscores the severity of nifaq (hypocrisy) as a distinct state from pure disbelief, warranting a specific divine retribution at the hour of death.
